rows.en: Hi {display_name} ... I'm here, ready when you are ... let's begin
rows.frozen: Arabic, exactly — wording, spelling and « ... » rhythm
rows.why: Carries the Arabic's three beats (greeting · presence · invitation) and its warmth without a literal "I'm waiting for you", which in English reads as needy or impatient. English "Mixed" is unchanged: the gentlest accurate word; "Contested" reads adversarial.

Arabic «سياق» is ordinary and approved. English may not ship "context" as a noun (VI-01), so the meaning is carried idiomatically: there is not yet enough to go on. Neither word asks the reader to do anything.
